description: Up to 100 subreddits in one call, by name: a `subreddits` list (the same per-item shape as the single-subreddit about read), `requested`, `returned`, and `missing` (names Reddit did not return because the subreddit does not exist, is banned or is private). One read at the standard read price. Example: names='SaaS,startups,webdev'.

names.description: Comma-separated subreddit names without r/, up to 100. Duplicates are ignored. Required.

name: reddit_subreddits_batch
title: Get Subreddits by Name
